item.title: fix(gateway): prevent restart replay after final delivery (#121908)
item.summary: fix(gateway): prevent restart replay after final delivery (#121908) Re-lands the reverted #121507 on the current custody contracts. The reply dispatcher now owns direct-send pending-final custody: claim before provider I/O, terminal settlement for delivered/suppressed/failed outcomes, proven no-send stays replayable, ambiguous evidence fails closed — so Gateway restarts can no longer duplicate an already-accepted final reply. Proof: ClawSweeper local review clean, exact-head ci-gate green, live Telegram E2E (one turn, one final, no duplicates). Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
